$derivation: coverage[m] = blocking tasks of m holding at least one dependency edge
Denominator excludes closed tasks (they need no edges) and recurring tasks
(D5: never on the critical path). An edge in either direction counts.
m_yh_live: blockers t_yh1..t_yh6 = 6, with edges t_yh1..t_yh5 = 5 -> 5/6
(t_r3 recurring and t_x5_done are both excluded)
Eligible for demand: milestone_id = m, not recurring (D5), status not in

demand: demandHours falls back to totalBlockingMinutes / weeks / 60 and
pressure is forced to 1. Venture weight and milestone hardness are not
derived from slack, so they still apply.
